outcome: Time from the first dose of dinoprostone to delivery
Time of active phase of labor
cohort: 158 women undergoing labor induction with intravaginal dinoprostone
finding: In induced labors, SFH > 34 cm (both corrected and uncorrected for station) is associated with a higher likelihood of difficult vaginal deliveries and operative vaginal deliveries.
mod_finding: Operative vaginal birth was more likely in women with SFH > 34cm.
